description: lockFileMaintenance is how transitive dependencies get updated at all. Renovate cannot apply minimumReleaseAge to it; pnpm does, from pnpm-workspace.yaml, when it regenerates the lockfile.

packageRules.description: Lock file maintenance has no release timestamp, so Renovate would leave its stability-days check pending forever. "0 days" only turns off Renovate's own check: pnpm still holds every package to the two-week minimumReleaseAge in pnpm-workspace.yaml when it regenerates the lockfile.
Our own fork, exempt from minimumReleaseAge in pnpm-workspace.yaml too, so a new release lands right away.
